label: suspect

unstated.what: Invalid/unparseable HTTP-dates in If-Unmodified-Since and If-Range headers must be ignored (return 200 full response) rather than erroring or comparing
unstated.quote:
lastmod = 'not a valid HTTP-date'

    resp = await client.get('/', headers={'If-Unmodified-Since': lastmod})
    assert 200 == resp.status

instruction_covers: Content-Range header on 206 responses with exact 'bytes start-end/size' format (format shown in issue #1)
clamping out-of-range tail ranges to whole file (issue #4)
honoring If-Unmodified-Since: past date with/without Range → 412, future date → normal/206 response (explicitly requested)
honoring If-Range: past date → full 200, future date → 206 partial (explicitly requested)
reason: The tests only add exact-format Content-Range checks, 416/clamp behavior, and If-Unmodified-Since/If-Range handling, all of which the instruction requests (the Content-Range format and conditional header semantics are stated or directly implied by RFC 7233/7232). The only unstated detail is that malformed HTTP-dates in the conditional headers must be silently ignored, a conventional RFC 7232 rule a careful implementer would usually apply.
